headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text:
Good morning,

I need to request tree trimming at the detention pond behind Shallot Way and Chickpea Lane.

The City-maintained trees along the detention pond are once again growing into the community's fence and are beginning to cause damage to Association property.

Can we please get a crew out to trim the trees back from the fence line before additional damage occurs?

Please let me know when t

Music is WAY too loud if illegally beyond the limit.  North end of the Rainey St bars, Bungalow and the one next to it.  Live band at one and crazy 2000s music DJ at the other.   Why do they never get visited by police for outdoor noise violations?

Are decibel limits and noise laws not real?  I don’t get it how the same bars always violate.   I have a decibel reader and measured from the street -

The trees at the McDonald’s on 183 and Loyola have died. The McDonald’s opened in 2026. It displaced existing trees. I imagine the site plan included trees to replace removed trees. Are these now dead trees required to be replaced by the franchisee?  There are many 100 gallon trees that were planted this year that have now died.

HAREC001. Summary: Street and Bridge Operations completed request.
Details: Thank you for your request. Street and Bridge Operations reviewed and completed your request. If you have any questions regarding this request, please contact Street and Bridge Operations Dispatch at (512) 974-8777 and provide work order number 26-217357 as a reference.

NOPROBLE. Summary: No problem found.
Details: Thank you for your request. Street and Bridge Operations reviewed and confirmed no problem was found. If you have any questions regarding this request, please contact Street and Bridge Operations Dispatch at (512) 974-8777 and provide work order number 26-217147 as a reference.
Advance warning signs for loose gravel due to seal coat. Signs stay present

EMERGENCY There’s a dog with an unhoused person near Phoebe’s Café who’s been wandering around all morning. I’ve driven by four times now and would offer help but the individual looks very unstable and it wouldn’t be safe for me .  the dog looks like it’s in distress and the homeless individual has no shoes on and does not look like it’s providing for the animal. The animal is panting heavily look

I would like to submit a noise complaint regarding Coquito. They are currently playing amplified outdoor music past the allowed time. The music is loud and can be heard clearly from surrounding properties.

Please have the appropriate department look into this and ensure the business is complying with the City of Austin’s outdoor amplified sound regulations.

Thank you.

Red Chevrolet sedan is parked more than 18 inches off curb, obstructing traffic in one lane. This is making for unsafe residential roadway. This is an AirBnb and it consistently has parking violations, obstructing the traffic and disrupting the neighborhood.

incomplete work.  Yesterday our street was treated with new gravel. However the crew left this strip uncovered in front of our house at 2202 Fancy Gap.  It's going to drive my old mind senile more than it already is.  The crew is still in the area. Please fix this.

There are two contradictory signs indicating whether the middle lane can turn or must go straight.

Also, if the new signage is right and the middle lane can only go straight, that's going to cause crazy backups at that specific light where every single day people stack up to turn left after turning right off Jollyville. That's a terrible change.

Completed. Monitored intersection through live graphics, historical timing values, and verified that detection was working at the intersection. The traffic signal is working correctly and according to plan. We will continue monitoring signal operations at this intersection and make adjustments as needed. Thank you.
items.address: W William Cannon Dr & Cooper Ln, Austin

items.text: The street lights exiting Bowie high school onto slaughter Lane will not allow vehicles to leave the Bowie parking lot. You need to have somebody come out and monitor these lights for at least an hour after school lets out we’ve been sitting here for 20 minutes and the light has not turned green on us.

The left-turn signal from W Parmer Ln onto Riata Vista Cir is not cycling. Vehicles in the two left-turn lanes waited over 15 minutes without a green arrow while opposing traffic cycled four times. This is a recurring issue, likely caused by a faulty vehicle detection sensor or signal timing. Please inspect the detection system. Thank you.

Cement “Turtles” on Berkman Dr are failing and need to be replaced with another solution (like Ziklas) as the turtles create hazards for cyclists and other bike lane users. This is a documented hazard because the detritus from the cement turtles gets in the bike lane and poses a falling/crash hazard for cyclists, including a risk that a cyclist or other will fall into a lane of traffic.

Work crew on Airport at Oak Springs has a truck parked right up on the protected street tree. This tree needs a chain link fence to protect its Critical Root Zone. They are required for construction. Parking this truck here will kill the tree, and this one is essential to keep this stretch of the bike lane shaded.

There are no trees along this straight on airport between denson and clayton ln. I asked about this earlier and hoped trees could get planted here but I was told this section is too narrow, however that appears to be a lie. Attached are images of other similarly narrow grassland that have rather thick trees. So why can’t this be done on airport? If this is forwarded to any other departments, pleas

Completed. Requester states that this signal's green is very short, and it causes there to be backup from the Slaughter & Menchaca signal, so the traffic will eventually build up so much that it takes a couple of cycles to get through NB/SB on Menchaca at Monarch.

There is a homeless encampments at the creek behind 2701 Little Valley Cove that needs to be cleaned and the homeless need to be removed. This is my 2nd request. I will contact the Mayor if it doesn’t get taken care of.

Past few Fridays around 1pm a dog sitter/man with about 10 off leash dogs walks them down the park through people’s belongings and becomes aggressive with park attendees when they try and direct dogs off their belongings. Dogs charge people and go towards their food and the man yells and threatens park attendees. It does not seem this man can calmly control so many off leash large dogs in a public

On Wednesday August 19 2026, at approximately 5:44 pm  I observed a woman walking onto my property with her dog. She entered my yard and allowed the dog to use the restroom on my property without my permission. I did not give her permission to enter my property. I have videos on my ring camera. I've made multiple reports of her and nothing is getting done about this.

We have had a lot of damage to our gardens of late and we’re finally able to see what was causing the damage. Two big dogs. One has a collar, can’t see if the black one does or not. We’ve not seen the dogs personally, but finally got a game camera as the damage was getting worse. I posted on Nextdoor but nobody has identified them yet.

both kiosks (meter #2119 and #2120) appear to be giving different errors. one is saying "door open, no ticket", then resets. the other just present the user with a flashing yellow/orange triangle with an exclamation mark and a red led flashes on the side.

Contacted Requester. Summary: Contacted citizen to set up meeting. Citizen didn't answer.
Details: We've gone out to observe the site. We observed that there is fishing line in the trees overhanging the creek by the dam. We can't reach these with the tools we have, so we have pushed this toward watershed for assistance. If there is other line observed in the park, this meeting is set up to inspect

There is significant litter and garbage in the median and along both sides of North Lamar Boulevard, beginning underneath US 183 and continuing north on North Lamar. This is the Loop 275/TxDOT-owned section of North Lamar. I’m requesting litter cleanup of the median and roadside right-of-way. The mowers did not pick up trash before moving medians and side areas.

Significant light trespass from street light number 376786 into our backyard and back bedroom, with the light from the street light shining directly into the bedroom. We kindly request a light shield be applied as well as replacement with a warmer, dimmer light fixture.

This is Shoal Creek at Silverleaf. There’s water running down, Shoal Creek and collecting.  There’s water running down stream. Which is unusual because the creek’s been dry and there’s been no rain. Wondering if there’s a water leak somewhere upstream.

Deceased dog in park and the body is located - The location is when you drive into the parking lot off St. John’s, you start on the asphalt trail along the right side of the park. It’s maybe 50 feet to the right along the bushes/fence line.

Hoping to get more information on next steps for rabies exposure case, cat is currently isolated at home and is doing fine, would like to know how to be in compliance with observation protocol, rabies vaccination has lapsed but will get a new one after observation is over

There’s been this bull a Bolm District Park for the past several months. It’s charged at people/dogs and has occasional ended up on 183 Frontage Road. We’ve been trying to figure out who’s responsible for loose livestock on city property. A few months ago we were told by someone from Animal Services it was Travis County Sheriff’s Office but they say it’s the City’s responsibility

Woman totally blocking the ADA walkway again . Screaming at anyone who tries to pass. 
Mentally unstable. Heat advisory in place. 
Same woman came at me the other day as I walked by videoing.
Music until 2 am again . Why won’t the city do something about this. This is ridiculous. The business is openly breaking the law every weekend, they need to be shut down .

The home owner at stated address on the 311 ticket allows her aggressive dogs to roam freely. Her dogs are known to be aggressive and they have physically attacked my dogs some months back and have been very aggressive towards others.

Completed. Monitored the traffic signal timing historical and live signal timing for the time reported.
East - west pedestrian signals are recalled in morning and afternoon for school using Schedule TOD Functions.
items.address: Burnet Rd & White Horse Trl, Austin

items.text:
While my wife was walking two of our pups this morning. A dog from the stated address attacked my wife and my two pups. 

I have reported this location on several occasions due to a loose dog acting aggressively in the past.
On Enfield Road eastbound just before the intersection at Hartford Road, there is a loose manhole cover which rattles and clanks when you drive over it.  Could be dangerous to tires and cars.
The street light on northbound S Congress at Music Lane has never worked and has been reported many times. It would light a crosswalk and is a critical safety area for pedestrians. Please fix
They removed the dog when animal control showed up. The dog is back out again today after the last report was closed for no contact. Please help this baby
parked in tow zone...please help cars trying to park now, because of this car
Truck parked in front of firehydrant not moved since last citation 5 days ago. There were two major fires in this area over the last year including in the junk yard. Extremely dangerous

Scheduled Repair. Summary: Waters on. Likely a timing issue with field maintenance, APR not liable for programming.
Details: All but last 2 fields have water. Completing work under other work order.
